task_meta.downstream_task: clinical speech dataset for depression detection
task_meta.goal: Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.

request: This is a Mandarin Chinese clinical speech dataset comprising 1,503 recordings from 52 participants aged 16--56 years, including outpatients diagnosed with depression (44.2\%) and healthy controls (55.8\%). Speech was collected through multiple elicitation paradigms, including interview, reading and picture-description tasks. Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.
reflections: formant_lpc: The user requests anonymization of Mandarin clinical depression recordings, skips run_mask, and asks to compare all methods. Historical clinical, cognitive, and emotion tasks that depend on fine acoustic cues often retain more utility with pitch or formant_lpc, while Resyn can substantially degrade performance. Run formant_lpc, formant_spec, pitch, NeuralVC, and Resyn in sequence and evaluate. Set with_mask to false for each conversion.
